provider.name: GenBank
provider.organization_type: public nucleotide sequence archive, accessioning system, annotation repository, submission platform, retrieval service, and international sequence-data exchange resource
provider.description: GenBank is the NIH genetic sequence database maintained by NCBI. It archives publicly available nucleotide sequences and associated annotations, taxonomy, source metadata, features, references, projects, samples, assemblies, raw-read links, and accession histories. GenBank participates in the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration with ENA and DDBJ.

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting GenBank documentation, record and feature formats, accession conventions, taxonomy, submission workflows, specialized sequence classes, APIs, FTP releases, validation, related NCBI resources, licensing, citation, and policy.
purpose.authoritative_notice: NCBI, NLM, NIH, and INSDC remain authoritative for GenBank records, accessions, submission standards, APIs, release files, policies, legal terms, and contact information.
